entries.def: 普林是身體本來就有、很多食物也含有的物質；身體分解普林，最後會變成尿酸。高普林食物就是普林含量高的食物。
entries.note: 尿酸大多來自身體本身的普林；動物來源的高普林食物，普林量通常比植物來源的高。
entries.label: 文獻回顧・定義

evidence.quote: Urate is the end-product of the purine metabolism in humans. The dominant source of urate is endogenous purines and the remainder comes through diet.
evidence.supports: def：分解普林最後變成尿酸；普林有身體本身與飲食兩種來源。note：尿酸大多來自身體本身的普林。

evidence.quote: Hyperuricemia or excessive circulating concentrations of urate, the final product of purine metabolism, is a major risk factor for gout and plays a major role in the pathogenesis of this condition.
evidence.supports: def：尿酸（urate）是普林代謝的最終產物。

evidence.quote: The food items included all high-purine content of foods (eg, all meats, organ meats, meat extracts and gravies, seafood, beans, peas, lentils, oatmeal, spinach, asparagus, mushroom, yeast, beer and other alcoholic beverages (including wine and liquor))
evidence.supports: example：研究列為高普林食物的肉類、內臟、肉汁（meat extracts and gravies）、海鮮（清單也含植物性食物與酒，見 reviewer_notes）。

evidence.quote: indicate that avoiding or reducing purine-rich foods, especially of animal origin (that tend to have higher purine content than those of plant origin), would help reduce recurrent gout attacks.
evidence.supports: note：動物來源的高普林食物，普林量通常比植物來源高。

evidence.quote: Limiting purine intake is conditionally recommended for patients with gout, regardless of disease activity.
evidence.location: Results – Management of lifestyle factors (recommendation statements)
evidence.supports: 網站用法（GT-2.1 限制普林攝取）。

entries.reviewer_notes: ACR 2020, EULAR 2016 and BSR 2017 use 'purine intake / high purine foods' without defining purine; the definition therefore rests on a review (Keenan 2020, single author, Semin Arthritis Rheum supplement) and Jamnik 2016. Zhang 2012's list of 'high-purine content' foods also includes beans, peas, lentils, oatmeal, spinach, asparagus, mushroom, yeast, beer and other alcoholic beverages; the example deliberately lists only the animal foods so that it does not appear to contradict GT-2.4 (soy beans and vegetable protein encouraged) — Zhang found plant purines only weakly associated with attacks. Physician may prefer to show the full list with that caveat.

entries.aka: uric acid / urate; serum urate (SU); hyperuricemia (hyperuricaemia)
entries.def: 尿酸是身體分解普林後最後產生的物質。血中尿酸濃度太高，叫做高尿酸血症，是發生痛風最重要的危險因子。
entries.note: 美國痛風指引：血中尿酸6.8 mg/dL以上，但從未發作、也沒有痛風石，稱為無症狀高尿酸血症。

evidence.quote: Hyperuricemia or excessive circulating concentrations of urate, the final product of purine metabolism, is a major risk factor for gout and plays a major role in the pathogenesis of this condition.
evidence.supports: def：尿酸是普林代謝的最終產物；高尿酸血症＝血中尿酸濃度過高，是痛風的主要危險因子。

evidence.quote: Urate is the end-product of the purine metabolism in humans.
evidence.supports: def：尿酸是人體普林代謝的最終產物。

evidence.quote: Increased concentration of serum urate (hyperuricaemia) is the most important risk factor for the development of gout.
evidence.supports: def：血中尿酸濃度升高（高尿酸血症）是發生痛風最重要的危險因子。

evidence.quote: Recommendations in this guideline apply to patients with gout, except for a single recommendation regarding the use of ULT in individuals with asymptomatic hyperuricemia, which is defined as an SU concentration of ≥6.8 mg/dl with no prior gout flares or subcutaneous tophi.
evidence.supports: note：ACR 對無症狀高尿酸血症的定義（SU ≥6.8 mg/dl，且無痛風發作或皮下痛風石）。

evidence.quote: Gout flare and serum urate (SU) concentration (and tophus for PICO question 1) were specified as critical outcomes for all PICO questions specific to ULT.
evidence.supports: alias「血中尿酸」＝ serum urate (SU)。

entries.def: 高果糖玉米糖漿是由果糖和葡萄糖組成的液體甜味劑，用來取代一般砂糖（蔗糖），常加在含糖飲料裡。
entries.note: 果糖是植物中常見的一種單醣，也是高果糖玉米糖漿的主要成分。

evidence.quote: High-fructose corn syrup (HFCS) is a fructose-glucose liquid sweetener alternative to sucrose (common table sugar) first introduced to the food and beverage industry in the 1970s.
evidence.supports: def：由果糖和葡萄糖組成的液體甜味劑，用來取代蔗糖（一般砂糖）。

evidence.quote: Fructose is a monosaccharide found commonly in plants. It is also a major constituent of high-fructose corn syrup (HFCS) in sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs).
evidence.supports: def：常加在含糖飲料裡；note：果糖是植物中常見的單醣，也是 HFCS 的主要成分。

evidence.quote: Limiting high-fructose corn syrup intake is conditionally recommended for patients with gout, regardless of disease activity.
evidence.location: Results – Management of lifestyle factors (recommendation statements)

entries.reviewer_notes: White 2008 is a single-author review from a private consultancy (White Technical Research); its conflict-of-interest statement was not checked (full text not accessible), but the compositional definition is uncontroversial. The exact fructose percentages of commercial HFCS (e.g. 42%/55%) were not stated in any accessible source, so no number is given. The site's remark that Taiwanese food labels often say 「高果糖糖漿」 is an editorial localisation that cannot be verified in PubMed; please confirm.

entries.def: 在這項美國研究中，1份酒是指：1瓶或1罐12盎司（約355毫升）的啤酒、1杯5盎司（約148毫升）的葡萄酒，或1到1.5盎司（約30到44毫升）的烈酒。
entries.note: 各國對「一份酒」的定義不同，這裡是該研究採用的美國份量。
entries.label: Neogi 2014・研究定義

evidence.quote: Explanation and pictorial depiction of standard serving sizes … a 12-ounce bottle or can of beer; a 5-ounce glass of wine; and 1 to 1.5 ounces of liquor
evidence.access: PMC full text (the word 'i.e.' before 'a 12-ounce' is dropped by the PMC extractor; full sentence confirmed by WebFetch of the PMC page)
evidence.supports: def：研究中「1份」的啤酒、葡萄酒、烈酒份量（盎司）。

evidence.quote: Standardized questions regarding alcohol intake included the number of servings of wine, beer (including light beer, ciders, and malt beverages), or liquor (either straight or in a mixed drink) consumed during the prior 24-hour period for control and hazard periods.
evidence.supports: def：份數是以前24小時內喝的葡萄酒、啤酒、烈酒份數計算。

evidence.quote: The risk of recurrent gout attack was 1.36 (95% confidence interval [CI], 1.00-1.88) and 1.51 (95% CI, 1.09-2.09) times higher for >1-2 and >2-4 alcoholic beverages, respectively, compared with no alcohol consumption in the prior 24 hours.
evidence.supports: 網站用法（24小時內「>1–2份」酒）。

evidence.quote: In a case-crossover study, consuming >1–2 alcoholic beverage servings in the prior 24 hours was associated with a 40% higher risk of gout flare than periods without alcohol consumption, with a dose-response relationship
evidence.location: Results – Management of lifestyle factors (alcohol paragraph)
evidence.supports: 網站 GT-1.T 的出處（ACR 以「alcoholic beverage servings」描述，約高40%）。

evidence.quote: a US standard drink (14g) would require a 6oz. (1 US ounce=29.6ml) pour at 10%ABV
evidence.supports: def：盎司換算毫升（1 US ounce = 29.6 ml；12、5、1、1.5盎司依此換算並四捨五入）。

evidence.quote: These are usually conceived in relation to the most commonly drunk beverage type such as the common bottle size (355ml) of typical strength (5%ABV) of beer in the US (14g) and Canada (13.45g).
evidence.supports: def：美國常見啤酒瓶約355毫升。

evidence.quote: Standard drink definitions vary across countries and typically contain less alcohol than actual drinks.
evidence.supports: note：各國標準杯定義不同。

entries.confidence: High (definition taken from the cited study's own PMC full text; unit conversion from a PMC review)
entries.reviewer_notes: The serving sizes are Neogi 2014's own definition (the case-crossover study that matches ACR 2020's description and that the site cites as S32; the ACR reference number itself could not be mapped because PMC extraction strips citation numbers). The millilitre values are arithmetic from Kerr & Stockwell's '1 US ounce=29.6ml' (12 oz≈355 ml, 5 oz≈148 ml, 1–1.5 oz≈30–44 ml), rounded; please confirm you want converted values shown. Neogi reports OR 1.36 (95% CI 1.00–1.88) for >1–2 servings, which ACR rounds to '40% higher'; the lower CI bound is 1.00. Neogi also states 'One typical drink is approximately 15 grams of alcohol' (not used, to avoid two different gram figures, since Kerr gives 14 g for the US standard drink). Local container sizes differ from US sizes.

entries.def: 地中海型飲食是一種飲食型態：多吃蔬菜、水果、全穀、堅果、種子和橄欖油，適量吃低脂乳品和魚，並少吃添加糖、鈉、高度加工食品、精製澱粉和飽和脂肪。
entries.note: 美國的類風濕性關節炎指引評估了多種飲食法，只有地中海型飲食有足夠證據獲得建議。

evidence.quote: The Mediterranean-style diet pattern emphasizes the intake of vegetables, fruits, whole grains, nuts, seeds, and olive oil; moderate amounts of low-fat dairy and fish; and limits added sugars, sodium, highly processed foods, refined carbohydrates, and saturated fats.
evidence.supports: def：飲食內容（多吃、適量、少吃的項目）。

evidence.quote: Diet pattern that emphasizes intake of vegetables, fruits, whole grains, nuts, seeds, and olive oil; moderate amounts of low-fat dairy and fish; and limits added sugars, sodium, highly processed foods, refined carbohydrates, and saturated fats.

evidence.supports: 網站用法（RA-3.1 建議地中海型飲食）。

evidence.quote: Of several diets evaluated in this guideline (e.g., vegan, anti-inflammatory, elimination), only a Mediterranean-style diet had sufficient evidence to be recommended, given the burden and costs that accompany adhering to a formally defined diet.
evidence.supports: note：評估的多種飲食中只有地中海型飲食有足夠證據被建議。

entries.term: 生酮、無麩質、純素、間歇性斷食
entries.aka: ketogenic diet; gluten-free diet; vegan diet; intermittent fasting
entries.def: 這些是有特定規則的飲食法：生酮是大幅少吃醣類；無麩質是不吃小麥、黑麥、大麥等含麩質穀類；純素是不吃任何動物性食物（包括蛋和奶）；間歇性斷食是反覆斷食，每次最長48小時。
entries.example: 間歇性斷食也包括「限時進食」：每天至少14小時不進食。
entries.note: 指引的「不建議」只針對治療類風濕性關節炎；有些人可能因其他疾病而有使用的需要。
entries.label: 術語共識與回顧・定義

evidence.quote: Specific formally defined diets evaluated in this guideline were: anti-inflammatory, Mediterranean-style, ketogenic, paleo, gluten-free, vegetarian, vegan, intermittent fasting, elemental, elimination, raw foods, whole food plant-based.
evidence.location: Table 1 (definitions of interventions), Formally defined diet
evidence.access: WebFetch (author manuscript copy on CDC Stacks, cdc_151745_DS1.pdf)
evidence.supports: 網站用法：ACR 評估過的特定飲食法包含生酮、無麩質、純素、間歇性斷食（Table 1 只列名稱，未逐一定義）。

evidence.quote: This recommendation is based on very low to moderate certainty evidence demonstrating no consistent, clinically meaningful benefit on physical function, pain, or disease activity specific to RA for formally defined diets other than a Mediterranean-style diet
evidence.supports: 網站 RA-3.2 的依據：這些飲食對 RA 沒有一致、具臨床意義的好處（PMC 文字中該建議句漏掉 'against'，故不引用建議句本身）。

evidence.quote: Although people with RA may have other indications for these interventions (e.g., comorbidities), this guideline focuses specifically on managing RA.
evidence.supports: note：指引只針對治療 RA；有人可能因其他疾病而有需要。

evidence.quote: Ketogenic diets are characterized by a reduction in carbohydrates (usually to less than 50 g/day) and a relative increase in the proportions of protein and fat.
evidence.supports: def：生酮＝大幅減少醣類（通常每天少於50公克），相對提高蛋白質和脂肪比例。

evidence.quote: Gluten is the commonly used term for the complex of water insoluble proteins from wheat, rye and barley that are harmful to coeliac disease patients
evidence.supports: def：麩質是小麥、黑麥、大麥中的一類蛋白質。

evidence.quote: A gluten-free diet usually indicates a diet free from wheat, rye, barley, triticale, kamut and spelt.
evidence.supports: def：無麩質飲食＝不含小麥、黑麥、大麥等穀類。

evidence.quote: Vegan diets, where animal- and all their by-products are excluded from the diet, have gained popularity, especially in the last decade.
evidence.supports: def：純素＝排除所有動物性食物及其製品。

evidence.quote: vegan diets (total plant-based nutrition) and lacto-ovo-vegetarian diets (this allows for the consumption of dairy products and eggs)
evidence.supports: def：純素與蛋奶素不同，蛋奶素才允許吃乳製品和蛋（故純素不含蛋和奶）。

evidence.quote: Ultimately, fasting was defined as “a voluntary abstinence from some or all foods or foods and beverages for preventive, therapeutic, religious, cultural, or other reasons.”
evidence.supports: def：斷食＝自願不吃部分或全部食物（或食物與飲料）。

evidence.quote: The final definition of IF, which refers to repetitive fasting periods lasting up to 48 hours each, includes TRE and was finally accepted in the consensus conference.
evidence.supports: def：間歇性斷食＝反覆的斷食，每次最長48小時；並包含限時進食（TRE）。

evidence.quote: TRE was finally defined as a dietary regimen with a fasting window of “at least 14 h” per day in humans and no explicit limit on energy intake during eating hours.
evidence.supports: example：限時進食＝每天至少14小時不進食，進食時段不限熱量。

entries.confidence: Medium (Tier 2 consensus definitions for gluten-free and intermittent fasting; Tier 3 review/SR for ketogenic and vegan; ACR diet list via WebFetch)
entries.reviewer_notes: ACR 2022 Table 1 lists these diets but does not define them individually, so each definition comes from a separate PubMed-indexed source. Known PMC pitfall: the ACR statement 'Adherence to a formally defined diet, other than a Mediterranean-style diet, is conditionally recommended [against]' loses 'against' in the PMC text; the rationale sentence quoted here is unaffected. Koppold 2024: inclusion of time-restricted eating under intermittent fasting 'was repeatedly opposed by a few participants'. The ketogenic threshold (<50 g carbohydrate/day) is Paoli's 'usually' figure and is omitted from the def. In Taiwan, 純素/全素 food labels may carry local (including religious) meanings beyond 'no animal products'; not checked in PubMed sources. The def (84 characters) is close to the 90-character limit; physician may prefer to split it into four separate glossary items.

entries.aka: refined carbohydrates (here: refined grains / refined starch)
entries.def: 精製澱粉指精製過的穀類：加工時去掉富含蛋白質和油脂的胚芽、富含纖維的麩皮，只留下含澱粉的部分。
entries.note: 相對地，全穀保留了穀粒的全部三個部分。

evidence.quote: The Mediterranean-style diet pattern emphasizes the intake of vegetables, fruits, whole grains, nuts, seeds, and olive oil; moderate amounts of low-fat dairy and fish; and limits added sugars, sodium, highly processed foods, refined carbohydrates, and saturated fats.
evidence.supports: 網站用法（RA-3.T：少吃 refined carbohydrates）。

evidence.quote: Minimally processed whole grains retain all three components of the seed. Refined grains are processed to remove the protein and fat rich germ and fibre rich bran, leaving only the starchy endosperm.
evidence.location: How do carbohydrate containing foods affect health? – Grains
evidence.supports: def：精製穀類去掉胚芽和麩皮，只留含澱粉的胚乳；note：全穀保留三個部分。

evidence.quote: Conversely, greater refined grain intake, especially from white rice, is associated with an increased risk of type 2 diabetes
evidence.location: How do carbohydrate containing foods affect health? – Grains

The site's 精製澱粉 (refined starch) is narrower: in nutrition writing 'refined carbohydrates' can also cover sugars, but the site lists 添加糖 separately, so the narrower rendering is defensible; the definition here follows Ludwig 2018's definition of refined grains. Physician may consider 「精製碳水化合物」. Ludwig also notes potato products behave like refined grains (not included).

entries.def: 飽和脂肪是脂肪的一種，常溫下通常是固體；動物油脂和植物性的固態油脂含量較多。

evidence.quote: The saturated fatty acids are usually solid at room temperature and the unsaturated fatty acids are liquid at that very same temperature.

evidence.supports: def：動物油脂是飽和脂肪的主要來源之一。

evidence.quote: For example, palmitic acid, the major saturated fatty acid in the diet, is synthesized in the liver from starch and sugar via de novo lipogenesis, and it is the predominant fatty acid present in dairy and meats
evidence.location: Role of saturated, monounsaturated, and polyunsaturated fat in coronary heart disease
evidence.supports: example：飲食中主要的飽和脂肪酸（棕櫚酸）是乳製品和肉類脂肪中的主要脂肪酸。

entries.aka: highly processed foods (closely related standard term: ultra-processed foods, NOVA classification)
entries.def: 高度加工食品是經過多道工業加工、用多種成分組合製成的食品，常含家庭廚房很少用的成分或添加物，通常買來即可食用。
entries.example: 成分表有高果糖玉米糖漿、氫化油、香料、色素或乳化劑等。
entries.note: 指引沒有定義這個詞；這裡依國際常用的「超加工食品」分類來說明。
entries.label: NOVA 分類・定義

evidence.quote: The Mediterranean-style diet pattern emphasizes the intake of vegetables, fruits, whole grains, nuts, seeds, and olive oil; moderate amounts of low-fat dairy and fish; and limits added sugars, sodium, highly processed foods, refined carbohydrates, and saturated fats.
evidence.supports: 網站用法（RA-3.T：少吃 highly processed foods）。

evidence.quote: "Processed foods" are defined as any foods other than raw agricultural commodities and can be categorized by the extent of changes occurring in foods as a result of processing.
evidence.supports: 背景：「加工食品」範圍很廣，可依加工程度分級；高度加工是加工程度最高的一級。

evidence.quote: Highly processed food purchases are a dominant, unshifting part of US purchasing patterns, but highly processed foods may have higher saturated fat, sugar, and sodium content than less-processed foods.
evidence.supports: 文獻中確有 'highly processed foods' 一詞（並未在摘要中定義）。

evidence.quote: Ultra-processed foods are defined within the NOVA classification system, which groups foods according to the extent and purpose of industrial processing.
evidence.supports: note：NOVA 依工業加工的程度與目的分類食品；超加工食品是其中一類。

evidence.quote: Processes enabling the manufacture of ultra-processed foods include the fractioning of whole foods into substances, chemical modifications of these substances, assembly of unmodified and modified food substances, frequent use of cosmetic additives and sophisticated packaging.
evidence.supports: def：多道工業加工、把食物拆解再組合、常用添加物。

evidence.quote: Processes and ingredients used to manufacture ultra-processed foods are designed to create highly profitable (low-cost ingredients, long shelf-life, emphatic branding), convenient (ready-to-consume), hyper-palatable products liable to displace all other NOVA food groups, notably unprocessed or minimally processed foods.
evidence.supports: def：方便、可直接食用（ready-to-consume）。

evidence.quote: A practical way to identify an ultra-processed product is to check to see if its list of ingredients contains at least one item characteristic of the NOVA ultra-processed food group, which is to say, either food substances never or rarely used in kitchens (such as high-fructose corn syrup, hydrogenated or interesterified oils, and hydrolysed proteins), or classes of additives designed to make the final product palatable or more appealing (such as flavours, flavour enhancers, colours, emulsifiers, emulsifying salts, sweeteners, thickeners, and anti-foaming, bulking, carbonating, foaming, gelling and glazing agents).
evidence.supports: def：含家庭廚房很少用的成分或添加物；example：高果糖玉米糖漿、氫化油、香料、色素、乳化劑。

evidence.supports: def：元素鈣是以重量計的鈣含量；note：碳酸鈣含40%、檸檬酸鈣含21%元素鈣。

entries.aka: diagnostic diet (e.g. pseudoallergen-low diet, histamine-low diet)
entries.def: 飲食試驗是經醫師評估後，短期改吃低「假過敏原」或低組織胺的飲食，當作個人化的診斷工具，通常只做2到3週。

evidence.quote: Furthermore, nonallergic reactions to food can trigger CSU exacerbation, and physicians should ask patients about such patterns. Based on this information, diagnostic diets such as pseudoallergen‐ and histamine‐low diets may be considered in selected patients as individualized diagnostic tools. Diagnostic diets should be maintained only for a limited time to avoid side effects and safety risks; 2–3 weeks are usually recommended. Importantly, diagnostic diets should not delay effective treatment.
evidence.location: 4.2.3 Identification of Relevant Conditions That Aggravate Disease Activity
evidence.supports: def：經評估的部分病人、作為個人化診斷工具、通常2到3週；example：低假過敏原、低組織胺飲食；不應延誤有效治療。

evidence.quote: In some CSU patients, pseudoallergic reactions (non‐IgE‐mediated hypersensitivity reactions) to naturally occurring food ingredients, and in some cases to food additives, have been observed
evidence.supports: note：假過敏反應＝對天然食物成分或部分食品添加物的非 IgE（非過敏）反應。

evidence.quote: A pseudoallergen‐low diet, containing only low levels of natural as well as artificial food pseudoallergens, has been tested in different countries
evidence.supports: note：低假過敏原飲食限制天然與人工的食物假過敏原。

evidence.quote: Does include low histamine diet as pseudoallergen‐free diet is also low in histamine. The evidence is controversial and different interpretations about what a pseudoallergen is or what foods contain them exist.

evidence.quote: Assessment of both ultraviolet-A (UVA) (320–400 nm) and ultraviolet-B (UVB) (290–320 nm) radiation suggest that each contributes via different mechanisms towards promoting cutaneous lesion development
evidence.supports: def：UVA 320–400 nm、UVB 290–320 nm；note：兩者都可能促成皮膚病灶。

evidence.quote: In contrast, longer wavelength UVA radiation achieves penetration into the deeper dermis and plays a role in keratinocyte apoptosis via mitochondrial oxidative damage
evidence.supports: def：UVA 波長較長，可穿透到較深的真皮層。

evidence.quote: Pertaining to exposure to ultraviolet A (UV-A) and ultraviolet B (UV-B), there is no new high-quality study since the last search of the previous BSR guideline
evidence.supports: UV-A＝ultraviolet A、UV-B＝ultraviolet B（網站 SL-1.2 寫法）。

evidence.quote: 26. People with SLE should be advised at diagnosis and more frequently as necessary to use high sun protection factor (SPF), broad-spectrum UV-A and UV-B sunscreen (1B) and to consider safe sun exposure strategies such as reduced sun exposure and the use of protective clothing (1D).
evidence.supports: note：建議使用同時防 UV-A 和 UV-B 的廣效防曬乳。

evidence.quote: For solar urticaria, the exact identification of the range of eliciting wave lengths may be important for the appropriate selection of sunscreens or light bulbs with a UV‐A filter.

entries.note: SPF只代表UVB防護；UVA防護要另看UVA標誌或星等。
entries.label: BSR 2026・定義

evidence.quote: 26. People with SLE should be advised at diagnosis and more frequently as necessary to use high sun protection factor (SPF), broad-spectrum UV-A and UV-B sunscreen (1B) and to consider safe sun exposure strategies such as reduced sun exposure and the use of protective clothing (1D).
evidence.supports: def：broad-spectrum UV-A and UV-B sunscreen（廣效＝同時防 UVA 與 UVB）。

evidence.quote: Broad spectrum UVB and UVA protection and regular application in sufficient amounts are essential for prevention of skin cancers, UV-induced immunosuppression, and skin aging.
evidence.supports: def：broad spectrum＝UVB 和 UVA 防護。

evidence.quote: It is important to note that when choosing a sunscreen, UV-B protection is indicated by the SPF while UV-A protection is indicated by the UV-A logo or the UV-A star system (i.e. one to five stars).
evidence.supports: note：SPF 代表 UVB；UVA 看 UVA 標誌或星等。

evidence.quote: Patients can use a broad-spectrum sunscreen with a minimum sun protective factor (SPF) of 30 on a daily basis, even on cloudy days.
evidence.supports: 網站用法：狼瘡病人使用廣效、SPF 30 以上防曬乳。

entries.aka: UV Index (Global Solar UV Index, UVI)
entries.def: 紫外線指數是國際通用、表示陽光中紫外線強弱的簡單數字；數字越高，紫外線越強，用來提醒民眾採取適當的防曬。
entries.note: 指數會受太陽高度、雲量、臭氧量、雪地反射等因素影響。
entries.label: 文獻・定義（WHO 指數）

evidence.quote: The Global Solar Ultraviolet Index (UVI) was introduced by the WHO and partner organisations in 1995 as a simple measure of the intensity of solar UV radiation, providing guidance for the population to use appropriate sun protective measures.
evidence.supports: def：WHO 等機構推出、表示陽光紫外線強度的簡單數值，引導民眾採取適當防曬。

evidence.quote: The index was adopted as a standard indicator of UV levels by the World Meteorological Organization and World Health Organization in 1994.
evidence.supports: def：國際通用（WMO 與 WHO 採用的標準指標）。

evidence.quote: Forecasts of UV Index values are now widely available and are intended to be used by the public as a guide to avoid excessive exposure to UV radiation.
evidence.supports: def：預報供民眾參考，以避免過度曝曬。

evidence.quote: Factors affecting the UV Index, such as the sun elevation, total amount of ozone in the atmosphere, cloud cover, reflection from snow and local pollution, are also discussed.
evidence.supports: note：影響指數的因素（太陽高度、臭氧、雲量、雪地反射、局部污染）。

evidence.quote: According to the World Health Organization and partner organizations, no protection against ultraviolet (UV) radiation is required on days with "low" values (i.e., values <3) of the Global Solar Ultraviolet Index (UVI).
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes：WHO 等機構認為指數 <3 時不需防護（網站 SL-1.T 以 3 為門檻）。

evidence.quote: Conversely, sun exposure on days with rounded UVI values of 2 can indeed provide doses sufficient to induce erythema in skin type II after two hours around noon.
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes：指數 2 的日子中午約 2 小時，第 II 型膚色也可能曬出紅斑。

entries.confidence: Medium (PubMed-indexed descriptions of the WHO index in abstracts; the WHO 2002 practical guide itself is not PubMed-indexed)
entries.reviewer_notes: The sources disagree on the year (Fioletov: adopted by WMO and WHO in 1994; Lehmann: introduced by WHO and partners in 1995), so no year is given. The site's CM-6.1 wording (higher index → more skin/eye damage, less time to harm) comes from the WHO Q&A web page, not a PubMed source; it is consistent with this entry. Possible caution for the lupus pages: Lehmann 2019 (Photochem Photobiol) found that on UVI 2 days about two hours around noon can produce erythema in skin type II, i.e. the WHO '<3 = no protection' band is not harmless for everyone; physician may add this for photosensitive patients. Organisation names as printed in the abstracts: 'World Health Organization', 'World Meteorological Organization'.

entries.def: 光敏感是指皮膚對陽光有不尋常的反應，例如曬太陽後出現皮疹。紅斑性狼瘡的這類皮疹，常在曬後幾天到幾週才出現。
entries.note: 有些人曬太陽後，也會出現疲倦、關節痛等全身症狀。
entries.label: ACR 標準・定義

evidence.quote: The ACR has defined photosensitivity as “a skin rash as a result of unusual reaction to sunlight”
evidence.supports: def：ACR 定義＝對陽光有不尋常反應而出現的皮疹。

evidence.quote: Whether noted from patient history or physician observation, photosensitivity remains one of the 11 diagnostic criteria for SLE as determined by the 1982 American College of Rheumatology (ACR) guidelines
evidence.supports: 背景：光敏感是 1982 年 ACR 紅斑性狼瘡標準之一（依病史或醫師觀察）。

evidence.quote: Thus, because patients may not consider flares that occur days to weeks after extended sun exposure, we encourage providers to ask patients about flares that happen up to three weeks after being outside for an extended period.
evidence.supports: def：皮疹可在曬後幾天到幾週才出現。

evidence.quote: Detecting photosensitivity may be limited by a potential lag period of several weeks between sun exposure and skin lesions
evidence.supports: def／網站 SL-M3：曬太陽與皮膚病灶之間可能相隔數週，因此不易察覺。

evidence.quote: Photosensitivity covers not only skin disease flares but also systemic symptoms such as fatigue and arthralgias
evidence.supports: note：光敏感也包括疲倦、關節痛等全身症狀。

entries.confidence: Medium (ACR criteria definition quoted in a Tier 3 PMC review; delayed onset confirmed by Tier 1 BSR 2026 PMC full text)
entries.reviewer_notes: The original 1982 ACR criteria paper was not accessed; the ACR definition is taken from Kim & Chong's quotation of it. Kim & Chong call the 1982 ACR criteria 'diagnostic criteria' (they are classification criteria), note that the ACR wording is broad and can capture other light-induced rashes (e.g. polymorphous light eruption), and propose their own (unvalidated) definition. 'American College of Rheumatology' is the organisation's full name as printed in its own PubMed-indexed guidelines (e.g. FitzGerald 2020).
